newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish LOT, DHL in cargo deal.
newsitem.headline: Polish LOT, DHL in cargo deal.

text.p: Poland's national air-carrier PLL LOT SA and DHL Worldwide Express have launched a joint cargo connection between Warsaw and Brussels via Germany, DHL said on Monday.

The connection, established earlier this month, is operated five times a week by a Boeing 727 cargo plane, capable of carrying nearly 22 tonnes during one flight, DHL-Poland director general Alan Cassels told a news conference.

LOT -- earmarked for partial sell-off, most likely next year -- is boosting its cargo operations. In the first eight months of 1996 it carried 10,500 tonnes of cargo, nearly 17 percent more than in the same period last year.
LOT cargo director Wojciech Znyk said the airlines planned to charter a plane on a long-term basis next year to launch a cargo connection between Warsaw and the United States.
The company hopes to increase its cargo operation by 20 percent this year, from about 19,000 tonnes in 1995.
